author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: open hand with three round-tipped fingers, a shorter thumb column at the right, finger separators into a rounded palm, and a small motion arc at the top left; reads as a clapping/waving hand. A first height set made the middle finger stand alone (rude-gesture read) and was evened out. The rejected drawing had finger lines crowded closer than 8.
omissions: One finger is dropped (4 fingers + thumb need 40 units of 8-wide columns) and the hand is upright instead of tilted (a tilted column series cannot keep integer joins).
drawing_plan: SQUARE; columns x 10/18/26/34/42 with r4 tips at y 20, 12, 14, 24; separators to y 30; palm cubic from (42,32) to (10,32) bottoming at y 42; motion quarter arc (6,10)-(10,6).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'hand': finger columns with round tips over a U palm.
